metadata.average: Current PDHG iterate. Restart to the mean of new iterates in the epoch, excluding its anchor (Applegate et al. Algorithm 1).
metadata.halpern: Reflected Halpern (Lu & Yang Eq. 26), with Eq. 10 adaptive restarts in the canonical PDHG norm.
metadata.restartPolicy: Average: Eq. 30 with the constrained Euclidean normalized gap. Reflected Halpern: canonical fixed-point residual. beta=1/e; first epochs t>=1 and k>1 respectively.
metadata.counting: Each horizontal-axis unit is one PDHG operator evaluation, including Halpern reset steps. This is not a runtime benchmark.
metadata.provenance: Independent calculation on the problem in Lu & Yang Fig. 1. Start (2,2), step 0.2. Not an exact reproduction of their figure or its unspecified settings.
